recommendation: Keep this no-change audit for core FHIR. Do not restore the historical core extension for FHIR-18689; handle any future clarification of the retired extension-pack artifact through FHIR-49169 or another final FHIR-extensions decision.
issue_request: FHIR-18689 was a Published Vocab change request, resolved Persuasive for STU3, asking to support the VSD Activity Status Date by changing the prior ValueSet expiration-date extension to activityStatusDate and updating the definition to match VSD semantics.
initial_application: Commit 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249 explicitly listed GF#18689 and added an activityStatusDate row with VSD-oriented definition/comment text to source/valueset/valueset-extensions-spreadsheet.xml. During the later source restructure, commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried that work into source/valueset/structuredefinition-extension-valueset-activityStatusDate.xml and referenced StructureDefinition/valueset-activityStatusDate from the ValueSet core IG.
additional_context: FHIR-28450 later renamed/scoped the artifact to valueset-status-activityStatusDate, and FHIR-34258 later removed that extension from core after ValueSet.effectivePeriod and related metadata-resource work made the extension obsolete. The combined branch already contains audit commits for FHIR-28450 and FHIR-34258. The only activityStatusDate-family StructureDefinition found now is a retired/deprecated FHIR Extension Pack artifact, with its future disposition still under unresolved FHIR-49169.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current core has ValueSet active, no active activityStatusDate extension definition or ValueSet-core IG resource, and a first-class ValueSet.effectivePeriod element, so restoring or editing the historical extension in core would conflict with later final Vocab decisions.

related_jiras.note: Later moved/renamed the activityStatusDate extension to valueset-status-activityStatusDate; already audited on the combined branch by 652cdd1348a2656a936b4ee64b9104b44ee99e6d.
